sections.h2: Reading a Lake City exterior one wall at a time
body: A house rarely wears evenly. On a typical subdivision home in Quail Heights or Hidden Acres, the south and west walls fade and chalk first, and the base of each wall stays damp from sprinklers and rain splash. Fascia rots where gutters overflow. On older homes near downtown, window sills and porch trim are usually the first to go. During the walkthrough, the crew lead photographs each elevation and prices the repairs that wall actually needs, instead of applying one flat rate to the whole house.

sections.h2: Choosing the coating for each surface
body: Exterior painting in Lake City, FL means matching the product to the material. Wood and fiber-cement siding and trim get 100% acrylic, which stays flexible through heat swings. Stucco with hairline movement gets an elastomeric coating that bridges small cracks. Doors and railings get a waterborne urethane enamel. Not sure whether your stucco cracks are cosmetic? Our article on Lake City stucco cracks covers what to look for. Wider cracks are handled by our stucco repair crews first.

bullets: Mildew treatment and a full wash, often a soft wash on painted siding
Scraping to a sound edge and sanding glossy areas
Rot, trim, and fascia replacement where moisture readings call for it
Re-caulking seams and resetting nail pops
Spot-priming bare wood and patched areas
Two full coats, with sprayed areas back-brushed or back-rolled
body: Washing is the step that gets skipped most often, and skipping it is why so many paint jobs peel early. We usually pair it with our Lake City pressure washing service so the cleaning and painting crews work from the same plan.

sections.h2: Timing an exterior in Columbia County
body: The best window runs from October through May, when humidity is lower and afternoon storms are less frequent. Summer jobs still happen, but crews start early and watch dew point and radar before opening a can. A full exterior typically takes three to seven working days plus washing and dry time, and most projects start one to three weeks after approval. For the complete exterior process outside Lake City, see our exterior painting page or return to the Lake City overview.

faqs.q: When is the best time to paint an exterior in Lake City?
faqs.a: October through May. In summer we work earlier in the day and watch dew point and radar so the coating can cure.

faqs.q: Should my Lake City stucco get elastomeric paint?
faqs.a: If the stucco shows hairline movement, yes. An elastomeric coating stretches over small cracks. Wider cracks get repaired before coating.

faqs.q: What warranty comes with an exterior repaint?
faqs.a: A written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years on exterior projects, plus the manufacturer's product warranty. The product line is named on your estimate.

faqs.q: Do you replace rotted fascia or just paint it?
faqs.a: We replace it. Painting over rot traps moisture, so rot and fascia replacement are priced as part of prep.
